raw: {"analysis":"KPX provides a more complete and actionable plan that addresses all critical constraints: it specifies exact 429 error messages, includes a canary deployment strategy excluding Apex initially, and properly sequences the dual-approval requirement. VPF's plan is solid but has gaps—it mentions a feature flag toggle without confirming it exists, its rollback plan for schema changes is less nuanced (full restore only), and it lacks a canary/staged rollout strategy which is important given the irreversibility of schema locks. KPX also better addresses the monitoring dashboard issue by specifying distinct throttle tags in the success criteria.","verdict":"KPX"}
